posts.linkedin:
Answering the same service questions on WhatsApp wastes hours each week.

If you run a clinic, a salon, or a coaching centre, prospects often ask for your services, starting prices, and contact details before deciding.

Typing the same reply in every chat slows you down and can cause miscommunication.

A single, fast‑loading one‑page website lets you list all services, basic pricing, and a contact link in one place.

When a prospect asks, you simply share the link. Updating a price means editing the page once, not retyping messages all day.

Send me a DM with the word SITE and I’ll give you an honest opinion on how a one‑page site could work for your business.

replies.reply: Hi! Yes, I build clean one-page sites for all kinds of small businesses across India, including salons, clinics, coaching centres, and local shops. What do you sell, and what questions do customers usually ask you on chat before buying?
